intro.en: Agricultural and tractor wiring harnesses cover cab controls, engine and chassis circuits, lighting, sensors, implements and field-service connections. We develop each main loom or replaceable branch from the actual machine, interface schedule and working environment—not a generic tractor outline.
intro.zh: 农机与拖拉机线束覆盖驾驶室控制、发动机与底盘回路、照明、传感器、农具以及田间维修接口。主线束或可更换分支均依据具体机型、接口表和作业环境开发，不按一张通用拖拉机轮廓图生产。

knowledge.en: A tractor harness is a family of zone-specific assemblies rather than one universal part. Cab, powertrain, chassis and implement branches face different vibration, mud, spray, UV, temperature and service loads. An ISOBUS-shaped connector alone does not establish ISO 11783 communication or AEF function compatibility; controller software, bus topology, power supply and implement functions must also match.
knowledge.zh: 拖拉机线束是由多个区域组件构成的产品家族，不是一种通用零件。驾驶室、动力总成、底盘与农具分支面对的振动、泥水、喷淋、紫外线、温度和维修载荷不同。只有 ISOBUS 外形的接头并不能证明 ISO 11783 通信或 AEF 功能兼容；控制器软件、总线拓扑、供电和农具功能也必须匹配。

notes.en: For quotation, provide machine make, model and revision, voltage, circuit and pin schedules, mating connector part numbers, loads and fusing, CAN/ISOBUS topology if used, branch lengths and installation photographs, movement and exposure zones, quantity, labels and the agreed inspection scope. A reference sample helps establish geometry, but undocumented repairs must be distinguished from the intended design.
notes.zh: 报价请提供设备品牌、型号与版本、电压、回路和针脚表、对插连接器料号、负载与保险配置、涉及的 CAN/ISOBUS 拓扑、分支尺寸和安装照片、运动与暴露区域、数量、标签及约定检验范围。参考样品有助于确定几何，但应把未记录的维修痕迹与原设计区分。

delivery.en: The approved drawing and first article freeze connector orientation, cavity map, branch datum, covering transitions, clips, service loops and test points. Routine continuity, shorts, dimensional and visual checks are recorded to the agreed plan. Sealing, vibration, flex, thermal and full-machine functional validation are separate project-defined tests; they are not implied by a passing wire map.
delivery.zh: 经批准的图纸与首件应冻结连接器方向、孔位映射、分支基准、包覆过渡、卡扣、检修余量及测试点。常规导通、短路、尺寸和外观检查按约定方案记录；密封、振动、弯曲、热和整机功能验证属于另行定义的项目测试，不能由线序合格推定。

introduction.zh: 一台农机，多种电气区域

lead.en: A cab loom, engine branch, rear-implement lead and lighting harness can all belong to the same tractor, yet need different connector, protection and service decisions. The useful starting point is the exact machine configuration and what each circuit must do in the field.
lead.zh: 驾驶室线束、发动机分支、后部农具引线与照明线束可以同属一台拖拉机，却需要不同的连接器、防护与维修设计。真正的起点是准确的整机配置，以及每条回路在田间承担的任务。

title.en: Separate cab, powertrain, chassis and implement branches
title.zh: 驾驶室、动力、底盘与农具分支应分别定义

copy.en: Cab panels, displays, switches and HVAC favor accessible routing and clear labeling. Engine and transmission branches encounter heat, oil and movement; chassis runs face stones, wash water and suspension travel. Rear lighting, trailer and implement connections may be unplugged regularly. A complete machine loom can be divided into serviceable modules, but every interface needs a released cavity map, polarity, mating direction and length datum. Tractor, combine and sprayer projects therefore share a method, not a universal wire harness.
copy.zh: 驾驶室面板、显示器、开关与空调控制更关注可接近的走线和清晰标识；发动机、变速箱分支面对热、油液与运动；底盘线路还会受到砂石、冲洗水和悬架行程影响。后部照明、拖车及农具连接可能频繁插拔。整机线束可以拆分成便于维护的模块，但每个接口都要有已放行的孔位表、极性、对插方向和长度基准。拖拉机、联合收割机和喷药机可共用设计方法，不能共用一条所谓万能线束。

copy.en: Main, cab, engine, chassis, lighting and implement branches can be quoted separately or as a controlled set.
copy.zh: 主线束、驾驶室、发动机、底盘、照明和农具分支可分别报价，也可作为受控整套交付。

copy.en: Place disconnects where an operator or technician can actually reach and identify them.
copy.zh: 断开点应设在操作员或维修人员真正能接近、能辨识的位置。

title.en: Mud, spray and vibration are installation problems, not adjectives
title.zh: 泥水、喷淋与振动要落实到安装细节

copy.en: Agricultural equipment may cross wet soil, dusty fields and chemical-spray areas in one season. Exposure differs between a sheltered cab, a wheel arch and a rear hitch. Specify connector location, mating seal, individual wire seals, blind plugs for unused cavities, backshell exit, drainage direction, abrasion sleeve and support spacing for each zone. A component IP marking applies only to its defined mated and installed condition; it does not certify the finished harness or machine. UV, fertilizer and washdown compatibility likewise require the selected materials and agreed test method.
copy.zh: 农机在一个季节里可能经历湿泥、扬尘和药液喷洒，不同位置的暴露程度却不一样：驾驶室内、轮罩和后悬挂不能按同一防护条件处理。应逐区定义连接器位置、对插密封、单线线封、空孔盲塞、尾部出线、排水方向、耐磨护套和固定间距。元件标注的 IP 等级只对应其规定的对插与安装状态，不等于整条线束或整机已获该等级；紫外线、肥料和冲洗液适应性也要结合选材与约定试验方法核实。

copy.en: Keep joints and service loops away from standing water and moving tyres where layout allows.
copy.zh: 布局允许时，让接续点与检修余环远离积水和运动轮胎。

copy.en: The plug, wire diameter, seal, cavity fill and mating half must form one specified system.
copy.zh: 插头、线径、线封、孔位填充与对插件必须组成同一明确体系。

title.en: Choose conductor and covering by load, heat and motion
title.zh: 导体与包覆应按负载、热区和运动选型

copy.en: Starting, charging, lighting, valve coils, sensors and CAN circuits do not have the same current or noise requirements. Wire size follows load, voltage drop, protection device and termination range. Fixed zones and articulated or flexing zones may need different conductor constructions. PVC, cross-linked insulation, corrugated tube, braided sleeve and heat protection are options—not a substitute for locating the actual hot surfaces, oil sources, bend points and clamp positions. Keep sensitive signals away from high-current switching paths where the equipment design requires it.
copy.zh: 起动、充电、照明、阀线圈、传感器与 CAN 回路的电流和抗干扰要求并不相同。线径应由负载、压降、保护器件和端接范围决定；固定区与铰接或反复弯曲区也可能需要不同导体结构。PVC、交联绝缘、波纹管、编织套与隔热防护都是可选手段，不能替代对实际热表面、油液来源、弯曲点和夹持位置的调查。设备方案有要求时，还要让敏感信号与大电流开关路径保持合理距离。

copy.en: Include return path, connector contacts, fusing and duty cycle rather than wire diameter alone.
copy.zh: 同时考虑回流路径、连接器触点、保险配置和工作周期，而不只看线径。

copy.en: Sleeve ends, branch exits and clips are common abrasion and bending concentration points.
copy.zh: 护套端部、分支出口和卡扣附近常是磨损与弯曲集中的位置。

title.en: ISOBUS is a system question, not just a socket shape
title.zh: ISOBUS 是系统问题，不只是插座外形

copy.en: ISO 11783 defines a family of agricultural data-network specifications; AEF describes interoperable functions and test programs across machines and implements. A tractor-to-implement lead therefore needs the specified connector pair, contact and power allocation, bus conductors, shield and termination plan, length, strain relief and rear-hitch routing. But fitting the physical plug cannot promise Universal Terminal, Task Controller or any other AEF function. The tractor, implement, software and required function set need separate compatibility evidence. The photo illustrates an implement-side socket, not a Super Smile finished assembly.
copy.zh: ISO 11783 是农业数据网络的一组规范；AEF 则定义并验证跨主机与农具的互操作功能。因此，拖拉机到农具的引线需要明确对插件、触点与供电分配、总线导体、屏蔽及终端方案、线长、应力释放和后悬挂走线。但插头能插上并不能承诺通用终端、任务控制器或其他 AEF 功能可用，拖拉机、农具、软件及所需功能集仍需单独确认兼容证据。照片仅展示农具端接口，并非超斯迈尔成品。

copy.en: Contact count, keying, cavity view, supply and bus assignment are drawing inputs.
copy.zh: 触点数量、防错、孔位视图、供电和总线分配都应成为图纸输入。

copy.en: Continuity or a mating plug alone does not establish ISO 11783 interoperability.
copy.zh: 导通或对插成功，本身都不能证明 ISO 11783 互操作性。

title.en: Tractor, combine and sprayer projects change the branch map
title.zh: 拖拉机、收割机与喷药机各有不同分支图

copy.en: A field tractor may emphasize cab controls, engine management, rear work lamps and detachable implements. A combine adds long runs to headers, grain handling, monitoring sensors and actuators. Sprayers may add valves, pumps, section control, flow and pressure sensing, and exposure to cleaning or agricultural chemicals. These are application examples, not claims that one stock loom fits every machine. The machine model, attachment options, controller architecture and maintenance plan decide what belongs in each custom assembly.
copy.zh: 田间拖拉机常涉及驾驶室控制、发动机管理、后工作灯和可拆卸农具；联合收割机可能增加通往割台、粮食输送、监测传感器及执行器的长距离分支；喷药机还可能涉及阀、泵、分段控制、流量与压力传感，以及清洗或农药接触。这些是应用示例，不表示一款现货线束适配所有机器。具体机型、挂载选项、控制器架构与维修计划决定每套定制组件的范围。

copy.en: Lighting, guidance, implements and cab equipment can change cavity population and branch length.
copy.zh: 照明、导航、农具和驾驶室装备会改变装针和分支长度。

copy.en: Installation photographs and datum dimensions prevent a correct circuit from becoming an unfit loom.
copy.zh: 安装照片与基准尺寸可避免回路正确、线束却装不进去。

title.en: Release the pin map before repeating the build
title.zh: 先放行针脚表，再重复制造

copy.en: The work package should identify the drawing revision, BOM, cut lengths, branch datums, connector and terminal numbers, wire seals, cavity plugs, crimp tooling, covering and labels. A first article checks length, breakout direction, connector orientation, terminal seating and circuit map. During production, inspections can cover crimp condition, secondary locks, continuity, shorts and visual workmanship according to the agreed plan. Pull-force, cross-section, insulation, sealing, flex or vibration tests need a defined sampling method and acceptance limit. The pictured ferrule tool illustrates termination practice; actual agricultural contacts require their specified tooling.
copy.zh: 作业资料应标明图纸版本、物料表、裁线长度、分支基准、连接器与端子料号、线封、空孔塞、压接工具、包覆和标签。首件核对长度、分支方向、连接器朝向、端子入位与回路映射；批量过程可按约定方案检查压接状态、二次锁、导通、短路和外观工艺。拉力、截面、绝缘、密封、弯折或振动试验则需要明确抽样方法与验收限值。图中管形端子工具仅作端接工艺示意，实际农机触点应使用对应体系的指定工具。

copy.en: Pin, connector or branch changes must update drawings and test fixtures together.
copy.zh: 针脚、连接器或分支变化应同步更新图纸和测试工装。

copy.en: A passing wire map is not a field durability or machine-function report.
copy.zh: 线序合格不等于田间耐久或整机功能报告。

title.en: A service harness must be identifiable and replaceable in the field
title.zh: 维修线束要能在田间辨识与更换

copy.en: Field service begins before a wire fails: labels, branch boundaries, connector access and protected spare length determine how quickly a technician can isolate a fault. When developing from a used sample, we document damaged insulation, improvised splices, missing clips and non-original connectors rather than reproducing them blindly. Confirm the equipment serial range, option set, mating components and circuit intention before releasing a replacement. A physical sample may show geometry but cannot reveal every hidden material or software-dependent function.
copy.zh: 田间维修能力并非等线坏了才考虑：标签、分支边界、连接器可达性和受保护的检修余量，决定维修人员能否迅速定位问题。依据旧样开发时，应记录受损绝缘、临时接续、缺失卡扣与非原装接头，而不是盲目复制。放行替换件前还需确认设备序列号范围、选装配置、对插件和回路意图。实物样品能展示几何，却未必揭示全部隐藏材料或依赖软件的功能。

copy.en: Model year, serial range and fitted options may change a visually similar loom.
copy.zh: 年份、序列号范围和选装件会改变外观相似的线束。

copy.en: Record uncertainty, confirm against drawings and freeze approved corrections before repeat orders.
copy.zh: 记录不确定项，与图纸对照，重复订货前冻结批准修正。

q.en: Is this one universal tractor harness?
q.zh: 这是一款通用拖拉机线束吗？

a.en: No. It is a category covering cab, engine, chassis, lighting, sensor and implement assemblies. Machine model, options, pin map, voltage and installation define the actual part.
a.zh: 不是。这是涵盖驾驶室、发动机、底盘、照明、传感器和农具组件的小类，具体零件取决于机型、选装、针脚表、电压与安装条件。

q.en: Does an ISOBUS connector guarantee implement compatibility?
q.zh: 有 ISOBUS 接头就能保证农具兼容吗？

a.en: No. Mating hardware is only the physical layer. ISO 11783 network design, controller software, power allocation and the required AEF functions must be checked for the tractor and implement combination.
a.zh: 不能。对插硬件只是物理层；还要针对拖拉机和农具组合核对 ISO 11783 网络设计、控制器软件、供电分配和所需 AEF 功能。

q.en: Can a worn sample be used to make a replacement?
q.zh: 能按磨损的旧样制作替换线束吗？

a.en: It can establish some dimensions and interfaces, but damage, field repairs, hidden wire specifications and machine-option differences need separate confirmation before the first article is approved.
a.zh: 旧样可帮助确认部分尺寸和接口，但损伤、现场维修、隐藏线材规格与机型选装差异须分别确认后才能批准首件。

q.en: How is a sealed agricultural harness verified?
q.zh: 密封农机线束怎么验证？

a.en: Routine electrical and visual checks are not a sealing qualification. Specify the mated connector system, installed condition, applicable test method, sample size and acceptance limit if ingress validation is required.
a.zh: 常规电气和外观检查不等于密封验证。若需要防水防尘验证，应明确对插连接器体系、安装状态、适用试验方法、样本数量和验收限值。

q.en: What do you need for a quotation?

a.en: Please send machine model and revision, wiring drawing or sample, connector part numbers and pin schedule, loads and protection, branch dimensions, exposure and movement zones, quantity, labels and requested inspection or validation.
a.zh: 请提供机型和版本、线束图纸或样品、连接器料号与针脚表、负载及保护方案、分支尺寸、暴露与运动区域、数量、标签，以及所需检验或验证。
